_comment: steamAppId 480 is Valve's public test app (Spacewar) for development. Replace it with your real App ID after paying the Steam Direct fee. There is no online server: each table is hosted inside the creator's game and friends connect through Steam.
_inviteComment: inviteBase: a static page (docs/join.html on GitHub Pages) that turns a copied invite into a "Join in Steam" button. It needs no server.
